DIAGNOSIS READY: Chondritis of the auricular cartilage rim (perichondritis) secondary to tympanoplasty.

This condition often presents with shooting pain triggered by pressure on the cartilage or inserting earrings, which matches your symptoms. The lack of significant drainage or swelling on the CT scan further supports a localized inflammation of the cartilage rather than a deep infection or cholesteatoma.
